dependencies.name: icon-composer (icon composition engine)
dependencies.note: Compiled directly into this binary — the actual icon-picking/letter-overlay logic lives there so other applets (and eventually the Securexe backend) can reuse it too. Not a separate install. Version is the go.mod pseudo-version — bump it deliberately (go get -u), don't let it drift silently.

requirements.name: Chrome or Chromium-based browser
requirements.note: Any Chromium-based browser works: Google Chrome, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, or Arc. Used to render the app's own UI window, same as the rest of this family of apps.
